title: Modals 3: the modal perfect
subtitle: modal + have + past participle for past ability, criticism, probability and expectation

blocks.text: We form the modal perfect with a modal + **have** + past participle.

rows.statement: You **should have told** me you were going shopping.
rows.negative: You **shouldn't (should not) have told** Liz what Bill said.
rows.question: **Should I have invited** Carol to the party?

blocks.text: Some verbs have irregular past participle forms.

rows.use: Someone had the chance or ability to do something, but didn't do it · could
rows.example: We **could have gone** to the party, but we decided not to in the end.

blocks.text: Use **could have** for things someone didn't actually do. For general ability in the past, use **could** + bare infinitive (see Unit 19).

blocks.intro: Compare general past ability with a missed opportunity:
items: I **could play** the guitar when I was seven. (= I knew how to play the guitar.)
I **could have played** the guitar. (= I had the opportunity, but I didn't actually play it.)

rows.use: Someone's past behaviour was bad or wrong · ought to / should
rows.example: You **should have invited** Carol to your party. (= You didn't invite Carol and that was wrong.)
They **must have had** a lovely holiday! (= It's almost certain that they had a lovely holiday.) They **can't have had** any sleep! (= It's almost certain that they didn't have any sleep.)
Helen **might have found** a new house. (= It's possible, but I'm not certain.)

rows.use: You expected the past to be different from what actually happened · ought to / should
rows.example: Jim **should have arrived** half an hour ago. I wonder where he is.

exercises.title: A · could have
exercises.instruction: Complete using the correct form of the verbs in brackets.

items.prompt: We could ___ the bus, but in the end we decided to walk. (take)
Although I could ___ the DVD, I actually got the video. (buy)
Alan could ___ to the concert with Sindy, but he stayed at home instead. (go)
They could ___ an earlier plane, but they decided to get the later one. (catch)
Could you ___ longer or did you have to leave then? (stay)

exercises.title: B · should / shouldn't have
exercises.instruction: Complete the sentences. Use should or shouldn't and the correct form of a verb from the box.

items.prompt: Mr Appleby ___ an umbrella with him. (It's pouring and he is getting wet.)
Jenny ___ her room. (Clothes are all over the floor.)
Alex ___ the ball so hard. (The window is broken.)
Tim ___ a fancy-dress costume. (Everyone else at the party is in costume.)
They ___ there earlier. (The tickets are sold out.)
They ___ so much! (They feel ill after a huge meal.)

exercises.title: C · Probability in the past
exercises.instruction: Complete each second sentence using the word given, so that it has a similar meaning to the first sentence. Write between two and five words.

items.prompt:
I expect Adrian did a lot of revision. **must**
Adrian ___ a lot of revision.
acceptedAnswers: Adrian must have done a lot of revision.
Adrian must have done a lot of revision

items.prompt:
I don't believe that Jim stole the money. **can't**
Jim ___ the money.
acceptedAnswers: Jim can't have stolen the money.
Jim can't have stolen the money

items.prompt:
It's possible that I have made a mistake. **could**
I ___ a mistake.
acceptedAnswers: I could have made a mistake.
I could have made a mistake

items.prompt:
There's a chance that someone saw us. **may**
Someone ___ us.

It's possible that Tim hasn't arrived yet. **might**
Tim ___ yet.
acceptedAnswers: Tim might not have arrived yet.
Tim might not have arrived yet

items.prompt:
I'm sure that Irene wasn't at the party because she was ill. **have**
Irene ___ at the party because she was ill.
acceptedAnswers: Irene can't have been at the party because she was ill.
Irene can't have been at the party because she was ill

exercises.title: D · Expectation
exercises.instruction: Complete each second sentence so that it has a similar meaning to the first sentence.

items.prompt:
We were expecting Dave to call, but he hasn't.
Dave should ___ .

They said they were going to deliver the computer at lunchtime, but they didn't.
They should ___ .
acceptedAnswers: have delivered the computer at lunchtime
They should have delivered it at lunchtime.
They should have delivered the computer at lunchtime.

items.prompt:
I was expecting the film to come out at the cinema last week.
The film ought ___ .
acceptedAnswers: to have come out last week
to have come out at the cinema last week
The film ought to have come out last week.
The film ought to have come out at the cinema last week.

items.prompt:
The shop wasn't supposed to close so early.
The shop shouldn't ___ .
acceptedAnswers: The shop shouldn't have closed so early.
The shop shouldn't have closed so early

items.prompt:
Was the programme supposed to start at eight o'clock?
Should ___ ?
acceptedAnswers: the programme have started at eight o'clock
Should the programme have started at eight o'clock?
Should the programme have started at eight o'clock

items.prompt: Ronny ___ have gone to Switzerland, but I'm not totally sure.
You ___ have lied to me! Why didn't you tell me the truth?
Helen ___ to have seen a doctor weeks ago. Why didn't she?
They ___ have seen the play last night as they went to a football match instead.
Carl ___ have been here by now. Maybe he got stuck in traffic.
You ___ have been really excited when you heard you'd won the competition!

exercises.title: F · My cousin Tina
exercises.instruction: Write one word in each gap.

items.prompt: My cousin Tina is a professional dancer. Her mum — my aunt — says that Tina (1) ___ dance really well even before she was able to walk!
When Tina was ten, she could (2) ___ gone to a special school for dancers in New York, but she decided not to because she didn't want to leave her friends.
Even today, Tina's mum thinks that Tina (3) ___ have gone to the school.
I'm sure it (4) ___ have been a very difficult decision for Tina to make, but she says that she doesn't regret not going.
She carried on dancing in her spare time, often getting up at five o'clock in the morning for a dance lesson before school. That can't have (5) ___ much fun!
In fact, she (6) ___ have got the main part in a new show in London. She's not sure yet.
They (7) ___ to have contacted her yesterday about it, but they didn't. Hopefully she'll hear in the next few days.
